title: Numitor
summary: Raleigh names Numitor in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Numitor, also printed Numilor, the elder sonne of Procas, depriued by Amulius, and grandfather of Romulus. The list calls him Syluius Numitor. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXIV, §. IV, sig. 348a
